name: Jet Black

canon_source.text: Add this to our side characters - and prepare for us to get some more images for him. His name is Jet Black - he is a watcher who works for Lisan Al Gaib

anchor.role: Solo front/body and visible wardrobe detail for this version; primary source for the next prepared batch.
anchor.observed_description: Solo full-body front view: round transparent cosmic sphere head with gold nebula and cyan rim, no human face; tailored black jacket, shirt, tie and trousers; polished black lace-up dress shoes. Brighter cyan lines trace shoulders and upper sleeves. Two stacked gold geometric marks appear on the tie. Character-right hand (viewer-left) is exposed cosmic blue; character-left hand (viewer-right, beside cube) is black-gloved. A floating transparent cube has pale cyan/blue edges, a gold center, orbital planets and a small galaxy motif.
scope_exclusions: Rear and hidden clothing/glove construction remain unestablished.
This rendition does not establish global supersession of REF-01 details.
Cube powers, tie-symbol meaning and character lore remain unspecified.
anchor.approval_scope: User supplied another Jet Black reference; proposed baseline for prepared still batch, not universal design supersession.
